thread:
maya-support: Hi team — AtlasWave signed up via OIDC earlier and they say API calls immediately return 403. They can see an API key in the Console (atlaswave-main-xyz) but it fails when used. Sam, can you paste their error?
sam-customer: here's the curl output they sent: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_atlaswave_main_abc123\" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-rl-1","prompt":"hi"}' \
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{
  "error": "permission_denied",
  "reason": "key_scope_mismatch",
  "details": "key not authorised for text-generation on project 'atlaswave-prod'"
}
```

maya-support: Thanks. They only signed up and didn't create project manually — we usually auto-provision a project and service-role binding. Weird that key exists but scope is wrong.

igor-platform: quick check — provisioner logs show a rebind event for tenant=atlaswave at 2024-11-04T15:02:41Z, followed immediately by a rollback. Looks like a race between tenant creation and role binding.

nina-oncall: can you paste the provisioner snippet?

igor-platform: snippet from provisioner logs: 
```
INFO 2024-11-04T15:02:40Z provisioning tenant atlaswave
INFO 2024-11-04T15:02:41Z created api_key id=sk_... scope=write:billing,read:usage
ERROR 2024-11-04T15:02:41Z failed bind: project not found, rolling back key binding
INFO 2024-11-04T15:02:42Z created fallback project atlaswave-staging
```

maya-support: So the key was created with limited scopes and never got bind to the production project. That explains 403 with permission_denied.

sam-customer: Customer says they only see one key in Console and it's labelled 'atlaswave-main-xyz'. They can't re-generate from UI because it's ephemeral on creation (we don't show secret after).

eldridge-enginfra: I can rebind and patch scopes. Short-term: we can create a replacement key scoped to text-generation and rotate it for them. Long-term we should fix the race.

maya-support: Can you run the rebind? Also what's safe for them to do right now?

eldridge-enginfra: Running internal command: `provisioner rebind --tenant atlaswave --target-project atlaswave-prod --ensure-scopes generation,embeddings` (internal tool). Will create new key and attach. I'll mark the old key for revoke.

deploy-bot: [deploy] provisioner v2.3.1 promoted to staging at 2024-11-04T15:10:12Z by eldridge-enginfra

eldridge-enginfra: Done — created sk_atlaswave_rot_9f and attached correct scopes. Sent key to Sam in secure channel. Also revoked the old unscoped key id sk_atlaswave_main_abc123.

sam-customer: Customer tested the new key and generation calls succeed. Thanks. Response times look normal.

maya-support: Filing an incident ticket for the race. Igor, can you add traces/PR link once fixed?

igor-platform: Will open a ticket and add a hotfix PR. Root cause: provisioner attempted key-bind before project was fully created; adding a weak retry/backoff and an idempotent bind check. PR: github.com/redwood/provisioner/pull/482 (hotfix).

maya-support: ETA for prod fix?

igor-platform: I'll request a patch roll to prod tomorrow after smoke tests. For now we patched customer and rotated keys.

nina-oncall: Noting follow-up actions: 1) confirm rotation logged in audit 2) add alert for provisioner bind failures 3) run account-surface scan for any other tenants that got fallback projects.

maya-support: Thanks everyone — marking resolved for AtlasWave. Sam please confirm once customer gets final invoice scoped correctly. :thumbsup:
